profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft | Agentic Code Review & AI Developer Tools | Accessibility
profile.summary: I like software, data, and people.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on optimizing all 26k+ Microsoft repos for Agentic development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building an AI agent that uses a UI automation framework (Playwright) to navigate through a page and do comprehensive accessibility testing, previously only achievable by manual human intervention.

Drove the creation of an ESLint plugin to do accessibility checking of static code in IDEs and pipelines.

Mentoring engineers and guiding teams on effective AI adoption as part of a cross-org initiative across Microsoft's engineering systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development on the new Github Advanced Security for Azure DevOps product. Emphasis on database design, development, and optimization. 
.NET with SQL Server back end, React with TypeScript front end.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Accessibility Insights team. Building tooling for engineers to ensure their products are accessible and compliant.

Tools worked on:
•	Accessibility Insights for Web — a Chrome/Edge extension for checking accessibility of web pages
•	Accessibility Insights Azure DevOps extension and Github Action.
•	Accessibility Insights for Android — an Electron application that uses ADB to communicate with device and check for accessibility issues within Android applications
•	Accessibility Insights for Android Service — a service for Android that helps in assessing the accessibility of Android applications

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: • Grew and managed a team of 6 engineers primarily responsible for proprietary supply chain management and online sales management software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built usability-focused web application for supply chain team to handle all forecasting and purchasing for the company.
•	Built and maintained proprietary online sales management software. Included integrations with Amazon, Walmart, Wayfair, and dozens of additional online retailers.
•	Advocated for accessibility on all internal and customer-facing websites and web applications.
•	Optimized company wide sales aggregation data pipeline. Decreased run time for data processing from 22 hours down to under 3 seconds. Opening up a wide variety of near real-time data analytics previously unavailable to the company.

positions.title: Contract Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Built mobile APIs and apps for both Android and iOS using Java and Swift respectively.
•	Developed several client websites both from scratch and using various CMS systems.
•	Obtained extensive knowledge of PHP, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and JQuery.
•	Implemented SEO strategies to help increase traffic and conversions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Member of “core” team that is tasked with building tools and utilities that decrease development time and increase efficiency for 31 developers spanning 5 teams.
•	Setup rigorous unit testing and a continuous integration pipeline to ensure consistency across applications using the shared libraries.
•	Developed a standard application architecture that will be used for all future web applications.
•	Developed a web application creation engine that generates ready-to-build applications with correct namespaces, settings, and architecture already wired up for developers to use.
•	Developed a data entry application using React.js.
•	Setup development, test, and production windows server environments for all 5 teams. Handled all windows server administration tasks, including batch files to help automate deployments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created and maintained the WAVE Accessibility Evaluation Chrome and Firefox extensions.
•	Rewrote the WAVE evaluation tool to use modular JavaScript, decreasing evaluation and load times from 2.5 seconds to 240ms per page on average.
•	Single-sourced the WAVE API, Chrome Extension, Firefox Extension, Web application, and Standalone API, merging five separate code bases into one cohesive code base for enhanced maintainability.
•	Implemented a custom build system and continuous integration pipeline for one-click compilation and deployment.
•	Added unit tests to all accessibility testing rules evaluated with WAVE.
•	Presented at CSUN accessibility conference in San Diego, a conference with 4800 attendees. 
•	Handled all Linux server administration tasks.
•	Worked with clients to provide web development services for applications. Including the main accounting application for the Center for Persons with Disabilities at Utah State University.
•	Worked on the main application for a $5 million grant with the U.S. Department of Education.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description:
At Virtual Internet, we use industry-leading VMware technology to match capacity precisely to your needs - adding or removing capacity in seconds. With Virtual Internet, you're guaranteed a reliable platform without having to manage the infrastructure that goes with it.


Specialties

VIRTUAL INTERNET CLOUD HOSTING
• Deploy applications in London, or Lindon, or both
• Reduced costs and increased computing agility
• State of the art VMware platform
• Fast, scalable, on-demand cloud hosting
• Public and private cloud options for ultimate flexibility
• Secure UK data centers managed by VI technicians
• Virtualized hosting built to your requirements
• 100% network SLA uptime guaranteed
